1: Allah us mohtaram shehar ki qasam khata hai, yani Makkah Mukarramah ki.
2: Aey Rasool ﷺ, Makkah ki fatah ke din aap ke liye jaiz hai ke jo chahein karein: jo qatl ka mustahiq ho usey qatl karein, aur jo qaid karne ke laiq ho usey qaid karein.
3: Aur Allah insaniyat ke baap ki qasam khata hai, aur us nasl ki bhi qasam khata hai jo us se paida hui.
4: Beshak maine insan ko thakan aur mushkil mein paida kiya, un sakhtiyon ki wajah se jo woh duniya mein uthata hai.
5: Kya insan samajhta hai ke jab woh gunah kare, to koi us ka kuch na kar sakega aur na us se badla le sakega, chahe woh us ka Rubb ho jis ne usey paida kiya?
6: Woh kehta hai: “Maine dher sa maal kharch kiya.”
7: Kya yeh shaks, jo apne kharch kiye hue maal par fakhr karta hai, samajhta hai ke Allah usey nahin dekhta? Aur yeh ke woh us se us maal ka hisaab na lega, ke us ne usey kaise kamaya aur kahan kharch kiya?
8: Kya maine us ke liye aankhein nahin banayin jin se woh dekhta hai?
9: Aur zubaan aur hont, jin se woh bolta hai?
10: Aur maine us par bhalai aur buraai ke raaste zahir kar diye.
11: Us se mutalba hai ke woh us ghaati ko paar kare jo us ke aur jannat ke darmiyan hai; aur woh usey paar karega.
12: Aey Rasool ﷺ, kya aap jaante hain ke woh ghaati kya hai jo usey jannat mein daakhil hone ke liye paar karni hai?
13: Woh kisi ghulam ya baandi ko azaad karna hai,
14: ya qehat ke din khana khilana, jab khana kam ho,
15: us bachche ko jis ka baap chal basa ho aur jo us ka rishtedar ho,
16: ya us muhtaj ko jis ke paas kuch na ho.
17: Phir us se mutalba hai ke woh un logon mein se ho jo Allah par iman rakhte hain, aur ek doosre ko farmanbardari par qayam rehne, gunahon se bachne aur mushkilon par sabr karne ki nasihat karte hain, aur saath hi ek doosre ko Allah ke bandon par reham karne ki nasihat karte hain.
18: Yahi log daaein haath wale hain.
19: Aur jo log meri un aayaton ka inkaar karte hain jo mere Rasool par utari gayin, wohi baaein haath wale hain.
20: Qayamat ke din un par ek band ki hui aag muqarrar kar di jayegi, jis se unhein azaab diya jayega.
